finding.observed_freecad_family: Five actual Save-dialog, document close/open, quit and object-tree insertion crashes reached QAccessibleTable::modelChange after rowsInserted or rowsRemoved.
finding.deterministic_reproducer: A stock QTableWidget lifecycle that materializes native selected cells and then changes rows crashed with SIGSEGV three consecutive times in less than 1.2 seconds per run on the previous installed overlay.
finding.control: Keeping Qt modelChange, selection/cache queries and autorelease-pool drain unchanged while suppressing only Cocoa update notifications passed.
finding.cause: QMacAccessibilityElement teardown deleted cell interfaces owned and cached by QAccessibleTable. A later modelChange resolved a cached ID whose interface had already been deleted by the native representation.
finding.relationship_to_FreeCAD_24t: The earlier parent-managed guard prevented synthetic elements sharing a parent ID from deleting that parent. It did not prevent distinct native cell elements from deleting their own Qt-owned interface IDs.

upstream_proposal.author: Yuri Barreira
upstream_proposal.local_scope: Exact Cocoa header and implementation hunks; upstream test hunk omitted in favor of the standalone stock-widget and FreeCAD runtime regressions.

native_runs.summary: The original lifecycle loop and explicit table, tree and QFileDialog model-change cases each passed 20 cycles against both candidate and installed plugin images.

operations: Exact retained A302 opened, shown and redrawn with stock TechDraw commands.
Stock TechDraw_ExportPagePDF used the ordinary nonnative QFileDialog and key-entered exact output path.
A selected FreeCAD object was inserted and removed from the document tree.
A second document was inserted and closed.
The exact source document was closed without saving.

pdf.summary: The new 4,033,108-byte one-page A2 PDF has identical layout text and zero differing rendered pixels at 110 dpi versus the independently accepted R43 A302.

validation.quality_gates: Python byte compilation, Objective-C++ warning build, diff whitespace check, authenticated build/installer preflights, final deep-strict app signature and exact resource inventory preservation passed.
